# CareReady Repository Instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md`, including its public-repository boundary.

Do not add strategy notes, working handover material, unpublished drafts, raw pilot or interview data, pricing or sales notes, credentials, personal data, or facility-identifying information to GitHub Issues, Projects, pull requests, commits, or tracked files.

Private work belongs in `.private/` or another ignored path. Do not bypass `scripts/check_public_repo.py` or the pre-commit hook.
